meta.title: Fix swift rosetta benchmark runtime
meta.body_summary: Improve `_now` handling and seed PRNG in the Swift transpiler to speed up rosetta benchmark programs, with regenerated code and updated docs.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex PR with 35-line change to Swift transpiler for rosetta benchmark speed; no review; closed months later as too old to merge, content superseded.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Very small 35-line change across 7 files. Consistent with a small-step performance tweak, but it was closed without merge due to staleness and content being superseded.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review occurred. Author closed the PR 8+ months later, stating it was too old to resolve conflicts and the content was superseded by main.
